title: Stacy D NDE 3985
content: I had overdosed on a barbiturate. I had three times the lethal limit in my system. I was lying on the floor passed out when my mom just happened to come home early from work that day and found me. When the paramedics arrived, I was not breathing and my heart had stopped. While they were resuscitating me I recall clear as if it had happened yesterday sitting up out of my body and looking at a man who was sitting on the chair close to where my body was. I recall laughing as if I was incredibly happy to see him and I felt like I had known him my entire life. He was sitting down. He had blondish brown hair and was wearing a white shirt with blue jeans. He had his face covered so I couldn't see it and he was shaking his head from side to side as if he was disappointed in me. The next thing I remember was opening my eyes to see the paramedics, who were both women, and my mom standing over me. I looked to where the man was sitting and there were no men present.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Suicide attempt Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Overdose, suicide attempt.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness When I was looking at him.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was looking at him.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I had absolutely no concept of time.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: During the experience I was not aware of anyone else in the room except this man.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw a man who seemed about my age at the time twenty-five, I didn't know who he was but I felt as though I did. There was no communication except my laughter. He was sitting on a chair before me.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm After this event i started having very weird dreams. And have taken some pictures that might be of interest to this.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I have had several dreams dealing with the end of the world. I have felt as though I am being visited in my sleep by spiritual advisors, people who I do not know but feel like I have known them my entire life.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Liberal I didn't really think about such things
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes Before I was very uncertain about religion and an afterlife, now I am convinced that there is someone who is watching over us. I now believe in Christ and live my life to serve others.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Before I was very uncertain about religion and an afterlife, now I am convinced that there is someone who is watching over us. I now believe in Christ and live my life to serve others.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I have an amazing amount of empathy for others now, I can tell when they are upset and sometimes why even if I hadn't been informed of the cause.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I have an amazing amount of empathy for others now, I can tell when they are upset and sometimes why even if I hadn't been informed of the cause. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I have taken a series of pictures which include a very clear eye and a red orb that appears somewhere near it, the orb is in the shape of a human but one who would be protected by a brilliant red light.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Later on I read in the Bible about God hiding his face or eyes, it is quoted in several of the scriptures.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I just have a very clear memory of it, the way he looked and how I wasn't in my body at the time.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I am aware that it sounds nuts and it could have been the result of a hallucination I just know it was real and what happened.
